title: Initial Default Dataset Setup
description: Set up observation data, choose a name language, and start your first quiz.

steps.title: Welcome & Database Status
steps.description: Taxo-Trainer uses GBIF observations for photo identification practice. If observations are already available, you can start in Quiz. Otherwise, follow these steps to import a dataset.

steps.title: Navigate to Settings & Data
steps.description: Open 'Settings & Data' in the top navigation. This is where you choose your name language, manage observation data, and adjust training preferences.

steps.title: Import Observation Data
steps.description: In 'DarwinCore (DwC) Occurrence Ingestion', use the prefilled local dataset path if the bundled archive is available, or supply your own ZIP path or direct download URL. Click 'Start Ingestion' or 'Re-Ingest Dataset' and wait for completion. Imports add or update records; they do not automatically replace existing data.

steps.title: Choose Your Name Language
steps.description: Choose 'Primary Display Language', then find 'Species Names' and click 'Look Up Names'. Danish is the default, but other languages are supported. Lookup retrieves available species, genus, and family names; coverage is not guaranteed. You can train while lookup runs, or skip it when using 'Scientific Binomial (Latin)'.

steps.title: Ready to Practice!
steps.description: Switch to 'Quiz'. If no questions are available, check that ingestion completed and that your family, taxon, and minimum-occurrence filters leave observations available.

steps.title: Practice with High-Resolution Photos
steps.description: Inspect a photo and enter a species, genus, or family name. Select an autocomplete suggestion to submit it. Hints mark the attempt as assisted. Open the Quiz walkthrough for shortcuts and the Settings walkthrough to adjust your training pool.
